hookups.source: https://indianastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/lieber-state-recreation-area/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=IN&parkId=570025 (site list, read 2026-10-20: 113 Poplar Grove electric sites, 106 listing 30 amp and 7 listing 50 amp; every site 'Full Hookup - no')

values.note: The booking site lists 113 electric sites in Poplar Grove and 93 non-electric in Sunny Acres; the DNR page says 120 and 96. Nine Poplar Grove pull-throughs. Most sites list 30-60 ft; a few under 23 ft (19-20 ft).

sites.source: https://indianastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/lieber-state-recreation-area/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=IN&parkId=570025 (site list, all 212 units) + https://www.in.gov/dnr/state-parks/parks-lakes/cagles-mill-lake-lieber-and-cataract-falls-sra/ ('Electric / 120 sites - Poplar Grove', 'Non-electric / 96 sites - Sunny Acres'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Booking site: electric and non-electric sites 'can be made for today and can be made up to 6 Month(s) in advance'.

summary: Fees stand ($20 base, electric +$13; the booking table's 2026-27 ranges are non-electric $20-28, electric $28-45) and the year-round season recorded today. Added 50-amp electric (7 sites; most are 30), no full hookups, 206 sites with 9 pull-throughs, dump station, 6-month window. Not stated on these pages: showers, water/sewer at sites beyond 'Full Hookup - no', max rig length (two pull-throughs list 111 and 127 ft, which look unreliable).
